items.name: GroupOrderingFull
items.summary: Tracks grouping state when the data is ordered entirely by its group keys

methods.name: input_done
methods.summary: Note that the input is complete so any outstanding groups are done as well

methods.name: new_groups
methods.summary: Called when new groups are added in a batch. See documentation on [`super::GroupOrdering::new_groups`]

methods.name: remove_groups
methods.summary: remove the first n groups from the internal state, shifting all existing indexes down by `n`

methods.name: reset
methods.summary: Starts tracking a new fully ordered input segment.
